{"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern","line":None,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_split compiles the anchor pattern before scanning the subject.","note":"The mbstring wrapper forwards the attacker-controlled regex into Oniguruma compilation and execution."},
{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5518,"var":"NODE_ANCHOR","code":"Anchor nodes are analyzed during tree tuning to determine empty-match behavior.","note":"The compiler computes emptiness information for a pattern that can match without consuming input."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"Empty-match classification drives the quantifier bookkeeping used by the vulnerable code path."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"The AST walker propagates the empty-repeat/memory state through nested nodes produced by the regex compiler."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"compile_tree","line":1044,"var":"OP_EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST","code":"else if (emptiness == BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_MEM) { ... add_op(reg, OP_EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST); }","note":"The compiled regex gains empty-check instructions for the repeated empty matches, the state that can later be misused."},
{"step":8,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"mb_split execution","line":None,"var":"split result","code":"mb_split('^', str_repeat(\"a\\n\", 5000)) executes the compiled regex over the multiline buffer.","note":"The runtime split loop consumes the compiled empty-match bookkeeping and is the sink expected to expose the bug if reachable."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
